name: s030-panel-resize

steps.note: Pointer down on the divider, 10 moves of 20 px to the right (the panel shrinks live, edge `left`: size = start - dx), pointer up.
Drag 100 px back to the left: the panel grows.

requestScope: persisted-atom-update writes since the panel opened (the width ratio under `app-shell:right-panel-width:v3` on pointer-up).
limits: At 1280 px the stored panel width is clamped to its maximum (workspace 935 - chat 320 = 615), so a drag to the left overflows into the chat-collapsed full view (DT-061, not this slice); the recording drags right first.
